project.description: Frozen inputs and reproducible derived data for the 2020-onward GEB Australian bird-community analysis.

required_before_release: Complete source versions, access dates, citations, and licences.
Confirm that redistribution is permitted for every archived external input.
Calculate SHA-256 checksums for the final archived files and sidecars.
Record the matching Git release and commit.
Replace this manifest status with complete.

scope.geographic_extent: Australia within the supplied study-area boundary
scope.site_definition: Point-topped hexagons with 2500 m opposite-edge spacing
scope.landscape_window: Circular 2500 m-radius window centred on each retained hexagon

source.licence: Depends on the contributing dataset; ALA's general preference for CC BY/CC0 does not establish the licence of every record in this frozen export.

external_inputs.role: Raw bird occurrences used for cleaning, spatial assignment, incidence-frequency richness, and species presence-absence data.
external_inputs.authoritative_reproduction_note: Use this frozen snapshot to reproduce the publication. A new ALA query may return changed records.

acquisition_reference.reason: The retained helper does not establish the exact taxon list, query boundary, acquisition date, or manual edits and does not request every field present in the frozen CSV.

quality_controls: Retain presence records inside the configured date window.
Require species, date, longitude, and latitude.
Apply CoordinateCleaner equal-coordinate, sea, and zero-coordinate tests.
Apply the 2500 m coordinate-uncertainty rule and its configured protocol exception.
Apply configured broad range checks for selected Tasmanian endemic and mainland-obligate species.

source.licence: CC BY 4.0, as supplied by the author; confirm the exact AVONET release and citation.

external_inputs.role: Species matching and trait data for the fourth-corner GLLVM.

mass.transformation: natural logarithm followed by centring and scaling across retained species

hand_wing_index.transformation: centring and scaling across retained species

quality_controls: Require positive finite mass and finite hand_wing_index for matched species.
Report species that pass occupancy filtering but lack matching trait records.
Align the trait matrix exactly to the GLLVM response-matrix species order.

external_inputs.role: Boundary used to generate the analysis hexagons and crop and mask both raw rasters.

source.provider: Australian Government Department of Sustainability, Environment, Water, Population and Communities
source.licence: Creative Commons Attribution stated in the supplied metadata; exact licence version requires author confirmation

external_inputs.role: Subregion polygons for regional convergence, GLLVM site grouping, and the Noisy Miner residualisation sensitivity analysis.

required_fields.SUB_NAME_7: IBRA7 subregion name used as the regional analysis unit.
required_fields.REG_NAME_7: Broader IBRA7 region used by the Noisy Miner residualisation sensitivity analysis.

source.provider: Australian Bureau of Agricultural and Resource Economics and Sciences (ABARES)
source.dataset_version: Catchment Scale Land Use of Australia – Update December 2023 version 2
source.citation: ABARES 2024, Catchment Scale Land Use of Australia – Update December 2023 version 2, Australian Bureau of Agricultural and Resource Economics and Sciences, Canberra, June.
source.licence: CC BY 4.0, except third-party content where separate terms apply.

local_metadata.lineage: The supplied metadata records ExtractByMask from clum_2023_v8.tif to the December 2023 CLUM 50 m v2 product.

external_inputs.role: Raw land-use raster reclassified into intact, native production, plantation, agriculture, and urban classes.

source.provider: NVIS product publisher to be confirmed from the raster release metadata
source.licence: Author reports CC Attribution for the vegetation data; confirm exact product licence/version. The supplied MVG fact-sheet licence does not establish the raster's licence.

external_inputs.role: Raw vegetation raster reclassified into vegetation formations and binary woodland.

derived_datasets.description: Analysis grid created from the study area in EPSG:3577. hex_id values are assigned before spatial filtering and preserved as character identifiers.
Occurrence records remaining after the configured temporal, taxonomic, protocol, coordinate, duplicate, and broad species-range filters.
Cleaned occurrence records assigned to exactly one generated hexagon.

fields.chao2_se: Standard error of the Chao2 richness estimate when available.
fields.chao2_completeness: Observed richness divided by estimated richness, capped at one.
fields.sample_coverage: Sample coverage returned by iNEXT::DataInfo when available.
fields.Q1: Species detected in exactly one incidence unit.
fields.Q2: Species detected in exactly two incidence units.
fields.chao_status: ok for valid estimates and failed otherwise.

derived_datasets.retention_rule: chao_status is ok; sampling_units >= 6; S_obs >= 5; chao2_completeness >= 0.70

fields.n_checklists: Number of distinct incidence units at the site.
fields.n_miner_checklists: Number of incidence units containing Noisy Miner.

fields.pland_wet_dense_2500m: Percentage of the window in wet/dense vegetation.
fields.pland_sclerophyll_2500m: Percentage of the window in sclerophyll vegetation.
fields.pland_mallee_arid_2500m: Percentage of the window in mallee/arid vegetation.
fields.PLAND_habitat_2500m: Sum of wet/dense, sclerophyll, and mallee/arid percentages.
fields.area_mn_woodland_2500m: Mean binary-woodland patch area in square metres.
fields.pland_native_prod_2500m: Percentage of the window in native-production land use.
fields.pland_plantation_2500m: Percentage of the window in plantation land use.
fields.pland_agriculture_2500m: Percentage of the window in agricultural land use.
fields.pland_urban_2500m: Percentage of the window in urban land use.

derived_datasets.missing_value_rule: Missing PLAND classes become zero only when another PLAND class confirms coverage for the site. Entirely missing sites remain missing. Patch area and cohesion are never replaced with zero.

derived_datasets.description: Aligned site-level landscape, sampling, beta-diversity summary, and spatial-coordinate data after complete-landscape and urban-cover filtering.

principal_fields.replacement_ratio: mean_replacement divided by the sum of the two mean components.
principal_fields.x: Site x-coordinate in metres in EPSG:32655.
principal_fields.y: Site y-coordinate in metres in EPSG:32655.

derived_datasets.description: Aligned total, replacement, and richness-difference Podani-Jaccard dissimilarity matrices.

excluded_legacy_inputs.reason: The current pipeline generates its own hexagon grid from study_area.shp.
The current pipeline reclassifies the raw rasters and estimates landscape metrics.

reproducibility.note: The Zenodo data release, Git release, and renv.lock should be frozen as one publication version.
